## Outcome
Tasks 6 to 10 accepted; Task 11 is left to a closeout member with my two decisions. (1) I am not loosening Law 5 for the window: while the home and a project's root are the same directory, that project's worktrees inherit the home's generated roots, so the seven WorktreeElsewhereTest cases stay green and a new test pins that a worktree's ledger/ becomes an ordinary path once the home is elsewhere. (2) The PreToolUse(Write) +13.36 ms is a probe-shape artifact, since the probe ran the worktree's own bin/spud and a linked worktree's .git is a file, so worktrees_fingerprint returned None and the cache was never written; but the cliff is real for any linked worktree, so the fingerprint must resolve a .git file to its common dir and the probe then be rerun with both launchers. Its re-scoping of test_hooks.py's globs to home: was right and is plan residue.
